source.note: 1995 Bowman Baseball. TCDB lists a 439-card single-series base set and a 54-card Gold Foil insert/parallel covering #221-274. The physical set contains two cards printed #294 because Cliff Floyd was misnumbered and was intended to be #394; VCS preserves the collector checklist as 1-439 by storing Cliff Floyd as #394 with the print-number error retained in Variant.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base remains one 439-card ProductSet with one completion percentage. The silver-foil cards #221-274 are part of the base checklist rather than a separate VCS ProductSet.
decisions.misnumberedCardHandling: The physical issue contains two cards printed #294. Chuck Carr remains #294. Cliff Floyd is stored as logical checklist #394 so ProductSet card numbers remain unique; Variant records that the card is printed #294 and was intended as #394.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Recognized true RC designations come from TCDB's linked rookie index. Only those cards receive RC in Player; prospect status alone does not imply RC.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean subject name plus concise collector abbreviations such as RC when appropriate. Long descriptions, error text, subset captions, and foil details belong in Subset or Variant.
decisions.subsetModeling: Base #1-220 are tagged Rookies & Prospects, #221-274 Silver Foil, and #275-439 Veterans for collector context while remaining one Base ProductSet.
decisions.goldFoilModeling: Gold Foil is a 54-card parallel/insert of #221-274. Hobby odds 1:6 are stored only on the ProductSet.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete 439-card collector checklist in one ProductSet. #221-274 are the silver-foil portion of the base set. Cliff Floyd is stored as logical #394 with the printed #294 error retained in Variant.

productSets.name: Gold Foil
productSets.notes: Gold Foil versions of base #221-274. Inserted 1:6 Hobby packs; odds stored only at ProductSet level.
